root_cause.analysis: During Persona Owner Contract run 37735601507 for PR #6197, step 'Verify real owners, paper scope, renewal and durable receipt reload' executed a large test suite of 1814 tests over 9 minutes. In scripts/test_dev_paper_diagnostics_failure_path.py::test_d3_8_composed_baseline_failure_capture_quarantine_compensation_success, start_fake_heartbeat spawned a fake heartbeat-loop subprocess and called wait_for_file(paths['heartbeat_identity'], timeout=4.0). Under runner load after ~9 minutes of CPU and disk I/O, subprocess startup and identity file flush exceeded the 4.0s deadline, resulting in an AssertionError. In local isolated testing with provisioned dependencies, the test passes cleanly in ~7.9s (20 collected, 18 deselected, 2 passed). The failure was a transient runner-load timeout rather than a functional regression.
